input.explanation: The division by zero is at line 47 of src/io_shop/spend_summary.py, in `average_spend_per_item_this_month`. The fix is in that same function: if there are no purchases this month, it returns 0. Its only caller is `render_spend_summary`, which is called from src/io_shop/account_page.py, and the patch leaves both unchanged. With the flag on, a shopper with no purchases this month gets a figure instead of a failed page. Nothing outside this repository has to change for that to work.
